saw_lines: Indian grocery buyers reorder the same staples, rice, atta and dal, once they find a store they trust.
So the first order decides the account. A new buyer who sees a clear price on a staple orders again.
Your ads quote 2800+ reviews in 4 ads and 3000+ in 3, so buyers doubt both. Pick one number and print it on every creative in the next batch.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 4 Nov 2026
points: Your ads quote 2800+ reviews in 4 ads and 3000+ in 3. A buyer who sees both wonders which is real, and that doubt stops the click. Pick one number and print it on every creative in the next batch.

7 of 28 copy ads open on “missing the taste of home?” and the rest are single use. That story is the only opener being tested. Test two new openers: free delivery over €39, and the 10kg Sona Masoori rice.

17 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product on screen. That extra search is where a sale gets lost. Point each one to the product it shows, such as Lentils & Beans or Basmati Rice.

4 ads have run 60+ days, and the oldest is your “No Indian shop nearby” image. That message works, so build three variations of it: one on the 10kg Sona Masoori rice, one on Schani snacks, one with a customer quote.

ads_1: New openers beside the taste story, led by free delivery and 10kg rice.
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook and Instagram, your two linked channels
